Definition: Candidate synthetic image identifier (e.g. candidate_000001)
Unit: Unitless identifier
Potential_Interpretation: Sample tracking across stages
Limitations: Must be excluded from model training to prevent ID memorization

Definition: Total foreground pixel area of the refined corpus callosum mask
Unit: pixels
Potential_Interpretation: Cross-sectional CC size; reduction indicates hypoplasia or atrophy
Limitations: Sensitive to segmentation threshold and image resolution (128x128)

Definition: Total length of the external boundary of the CC mask
Formula_or_Implementation: Sum of boundary contour segments using OpenCV findContours
Unit: pixels
Potential_Interpretation: Boundary complexity and overall structural contour length
Limitations: Susceptible to boundary pixel noise and jaggedness

Definition: Horizontal or vertical extent of the minimal bounding box enclosing the CC
Unit: pixels
Potential_Interpretation: Anterior-posterior or superior-inferior anatomical extent
Limitations: Orientation dependent; assumes standard sagittal alignment

Definition: Horizontal or vertical extent of the minimal bounding box enclosing the CC
Unit: pixels
Potential_Interpretation: Anterior-posterior or superior-inferior anatomical extent
Limitations: Orientation dependent; assumes standard sagittal alignment

Definition: Spatial center of mass coordinates along X axis
Unit: pixels
Potential_Interpretation: Spatial localization of the corpus callosum within the image patch
Limitations: Reflects bounding box framing rather than intrinsic callosal shape

Definition: Spatial center of mass coordinates along Y axis
Unit: pixels
Potential_Interpretation: Spatial localization of the corpus callosum within the image patch
Limitations: Reflects bounding box framing rather than intrinsic callosal shape

Definition: Length of the topological medial axis skeleton of the CC
Formula_or_Implementation: Count of skeleton pixels extracted via morphological skeletonization
Unit: pixels
Potential_Interpretation: Curvilinear length of the callosal body from rostrum to splenium
Limitations: Branching artifacts in distorted synthetic masks can artificially inflate length

Definition: Average perpendicular distance across the CC along the medial axis
Formula_or_Implementation: Mean of Euclidean distance transform values evaluated along the skeleton
Unit: pixels
Potential_Interpretation: Overall callosal thickness; thinning reflects delayed myelination / atrophy
Limitations: Accuracy depends directly on correct medial axis localization

Definition: Maximum perpendicular thickness observed across the CC profile
Formula_or_Implementation: Maximum value of distance transform along the skeleton
Unit: pixels
Potential_Interpretation: Reflects thickest callosal subregion (typically splenium or genu)
Limitations: Vulnerable to localized segmentation protrusions
